Assembly render mode is explicit

Audio metadata is AAC 48 kHz stereo
video endpoint differs from the original WAV by no more than one codec frame plus 2 ms
video start remains at the original time origin within declared codec tolerance
audio endpoint differs from the original WAV by no more than one codec frame plus 2 ms
audio start remains at the original time origin within declared codec tolerance
Container duration agrees with the original WAV within combined endpoint tolerance
Complete FFmpeg decode exits zero with strict errors enabled
Full decode emits terminal progress=end
Full decode reports a positive terminal video frame count
Actual decoded video frame count equals the MP4 declared video count
Full decode reaches the original timeline endpoint within codec tolerance
Numerical PCM audit reads the exact original bound master WAV
Movie, sidecar and capture inputs remain unchanged throughout inspection

limits: The exact source label is bound to the assembler record, not independently derived from game binaries; use the separate package/runtime verification.
Format, byte identity and full decode completion are separate from visual gameplay review, perceptual audio audition, native input and performance.
Source WAV measurements describe original PCM. Encoded AAC audio is fully decoded for errors but not compared sample-for-sample with lossy source audio.
Existing outputs and originals are preserved. Path-bearing command, error and progress diagnostics remain private.

source_capture.timebase_limit: audio_seconds is screenshot callback platform time minus the CPU timestamp immediately after StartRecordingOutput; audio render scheduling offset is not measured
source_capture.frame_treatment: First actual image held from audio time zero; subsequent actual images held by original callback timestamps; last image held to unmodified WAV endpoint. Millisecond concat timebase, CFR30 samples may duplicate/drop captured images; no generated pixels, crop, overlays, motion interpolation or retiming to hide stalls.
source_capture.audio_treatment: AAC transcode of the original engine WAV on its original timeline; no replacement, padding, tempo change or synthetic silence. Codec/container endpoint quantization requires separate output probing. This does not establish timbre/localization approval.

probe.method: Container and stream metadata only; no PyAV frame decode.

streams.declared_frames_limit: AAC coded-frame metadata; not decoded PCM sample frames.

endpoint_tolerances_seconds.limit: Codec/container endpoint checks do not measure perceived audiovisual synchronization or the capture clock start offset.

decode.scope: Both mapped streams fully decoded to null; no seek, duration or frame limit. Video frame passthrough.
